title: Hearing Aids Started At $300 Instead Of Requiring A Prescription
hook: A $300 starting price put hearing aids within reach of more shoppers.
closing: Lower prices expand options, but choosing hearing help still means matching the device to the person's needs.
question: What would make hearing aids easier to access?

segments.say: Over-the-counter hearing aid pairs started at $300 in this comparison. The prescription pair cost far more.
Only 20% of adults with hearing loss used hearing aids in these data. Most were not using that support.
Registered over-the-counter hearing aid models reached 80 in the supplied count. Shoppers gained choices that previously were unavailable.
